div.head: I Cn 18b
div.ab: Ac þonne we sceolan habban anfeald lean ðæs þe we on life ær geworhtan; wá þam þonne, þe ær geearnode hellewite!
Ac þonne we sculon anfeald lean habban þæs þe we on life ær geworhton; wa þam, þe ær gearnode hellewite!
Ac we ðonne sceolon habban anfeald lean ðæs ðe we on life ær geworhton; wa ðam ðonne, ðe ær geærnode hellewíte!
Tunc sane recipiemus uniforme stipendium secundum opera nostra; ue illi qui promeruerit sempiterna supplicia!
Ac we ðonne sceolon habban anfeald lean ðæs ðe we on life ær geworhton; wa ðam ðonne ðe ær geærnode hellewíte!
But we shall then receive simply the reward for what we have done in our lifetime. Woe then to him who has earned the torment of hell.
Aber dann werden wir einfachen Lohn dafür, was wir im Leben zuvor gethan haben, empfangen; wehe dann dem, der früher Höllenstrafe verdient hat!
But then we shall have a single reward for what we did before in life; woe then to him who has earned hell-torment!
div.note: Robertson (p. 139) takes I Cn from B, which begins at ‘mæssedæg’ in 14.2, the earlier clauses being supplied from G
